sutta: 13.7 buddha said monks i know not of any other single person who so perfectly keeps rolling the supreme wheel of dhamma set rolling by the tata gata as does sariputta is the one who perfectly keeps rolling the supreme wheel of dhamma set rolling by the tata gata as you all probably know the tata gata is another word for the buddha the tagatha means the dust corn one this suta i choose to mention it not because it has some a lot of dharma content but because there are some books in them in the mahayana sutras that seem to say the opposite thing for example in the lotus sutra they try to say that the buddha that the sariputta being and arahan did not understand the teachings of the buddha and instead they tried to show that all the bodhisattvas understood the real teachings of the buddha whereas in this suta the buddha says nobody keeps the dhamma wheel rolling so perfectly as sariputta which of course is completely opposite to what the mahayana sutra say
